title: Lancaster HK575 Memorial, Château-Voué
memorial_details: A memorial at Château-Voué maintained annually by French Army veterans. The precise memorial type, inscription, and location within the commune have not been confirmed from accessible sources. The French WW2 aviation crash database crash-aerien.aero, the primary source for Moselle crash sites, had an expired SSL certificate at the time of research.
crew_summary: Crew details not yet recovered from accessible sources.
